# Realphonevalidation

RealPhoneValidation offers real-time phone number validation services, providing information on connectivity, phone type, carrier, and more.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/realphonevalidation/.

## Actions

- **Check Phone Active Status** (read-only): Determine if a phone number is active on a valid phone service provider.
- **Email Verification** (read-only): Validate an email address and check connectivity and disposability.
- **Reassigned Number Lookup** (read-only): Check if a phone number has been reassigned since a given consent date.
- **RPV Turbo V3 Phone Validation** (read-only): Perform real-time phone number validation (status, type, carrier, caller name/type).
- **Scrub Plus Phone Numbers** (read-only): Scrub phone numbers in bulk for connection status and type.
- **Wireless ID** (read-only): Identify whether a us phone number is landline or wireless.
